context: A shop manager Yamada chats with a customer about racquets
purpose: Teach: 山田/低く/背中/ラスト/コート/ヒント/店長/争い

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: いらっしゃいませ。店長の山田です、今日は何をお探しでしょうか。
lines.en: Welcome. I'm Yamada, the store manager—what are you looking for today?
lines.style: Polite, warm shopkeeper greeting with self-introduction.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: あの、テニスのラケットが欲しくて。コートで使う新しいやつ、選び方のヒントもらえますか?
lines.en: Um, I want a tennis racquet—a new one for the court. Could I get some hints on how to choose?
lines.style: Casual teenage girl asking shyly for advice from shopkeeper.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: もちろんです。最近うちで一番人気なのは、軽くて低く飛んでくるボールも返しやすいモデルですよ。
lines.en: Of course. Our most popular model recently is light and great for returning low-flying balls too.
lines.style: Helpful store manager explaining product features clearly to teen.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: へえ。私、サーブのとき背中が痛くなるんですけど、それでも大丈夫ですか?
lines.en: Oh wow. My back hurts when I serve—would that one still be okay for me?
lines.style: Teen sharing a personal concern in friendly honest tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: それなら振動を吸収するタイプがおすすめです。プロも使っているモデルなので安心ですよ。
lines.en: Then I'd recommend the vibration-absorbing type. Even pros use this model, so you can trust it.
lines.style: Friendly manager reassuring customer with confident product pitch.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 実は来週、地区大会の決勝で優勝争いがあって、ラストチャンスなんです。
lines.en: Actually next week there's a title fight in the district finals, and it's my last chance.
lines.style: Excited but nervous teenager revealing personal stakes.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: それは大事な試合ですね。じゃあ予備のガットも一緒にお付けしておきましょう。
lines.en: That's an important match. Then let me include a spare set of strings as well.
lines.style: Considerate manager offering thoughtful extra service to customer.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ありがとうございます、店長さん!絶対勝ってきます!
lines.en: Thank you so much, manager! I'm definitely going to win!
lines.style: Energetic, grateful teen with bright fierce determination.
